newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA'S DOMESTIC BRAND PC SALES SOAR IN FIRST HALF.
newsitem.headline: CHINA'S DOMESTIC BRAND PC SALES SOAR IN FIRST HALF.

text.p: China sold 820,000 domestic brand personal computers (PCs) in the first six months of 1997, up 94.2 percent from the year-ago period, the Market Daily said on Wednesday.

The output value of China's PC industry reached 57 billion yuan in January-June, the newspaper said, quoting figures released by the Ministry of Electronics Industry. It did not give comparative figures.
China's foreign trade of computers and related products hit $5.7 billion in the first six months of this year, including $3.7 billion in exports, the newspaper said, but gave no further details.
